readback.name: Poincare.HamiltonScalarGradientQuotientBound.quotient_reaction_le_eight_of_square_completions
readback.mathematical_statement: For arbitrary real R, S, H, P, N, A, G, r, and Q, assume exactly R > 0, 2 R P <= 4 R squared A + S N, and R squared H - R G + S squared >= 0. Then -2 H/R + 4 P/R - 2 S N/R squared + 2 G/R squared - 2 S squared/R cubed - (4/3) r Q <= 8 A - (4/3) r Q. No signs or geometric meanings are assumed for the other variables. The common normalized term cancels for arbitrary r and Q. Dividing the first inequality by R squared and multiplying by 2 bounds the mixed contribution by 8 A; dividing the second by R cubed shows that the Hessian contribution is nonpositive. This is a correct real arithmetic implication, with the two inequalities supplied as hypotheses; it does not construct intrinsic tensor estimates or a Ricci-flow solution.
